scope: Native M1 Max MLX 0.32.2 numerical oracle, not M1 performance evidence
control: Captured layer-zero Q4 prefill inputs; compare quantized_matmul with dequantized matrix products
mechanism: Native qmm_splitk targets 512 threadgroups, partitions K on quantization-group boundaries, writes storage-precision partial products, then reduces them. Reconstructing this with native dequantize, partitioned matmul and sum matches every captured product.
implementation_status: Linux prefill kernel still lacks this partition-round-reduce behavior; no integration or parity claim
